stem: What is the breakdown of hereditary versus non-hereditary mutations in cases of retinoblastoma?
explanation: The source specifies that one-quarter of cases are due to germinal mutations, while the rest are non-hereditary somatic mutations.
rationale: Recall the percentages associated with somatic versus germinal mutations in the lecture.

optionExplanations.A: This suggests an even split, whereas the source indicates that the majority of cases occur sporadically.
optionExplanations.B: This incorrectly identifies the majority of cases as being passed down through germ cells.
optionExplanations.C: The source specifies that one-quarter of cases are due to germinal mutations, while the rest are non-hereditary somatic mutations.
optionExplanations.D: This underestimates the significance of the genetic component that requires genetic counseling for the family.
